patch_list: Disables FLAG_SECURE window restrictions to allow taking screenshots and screen recordings of documents, media, and chat in MEGA, and bypasses local export restrictions.
Block Promos, Quota Popups & Declutter - MEGA

Strips Pro upgrade prompts, cloud storage and transfer quota warning banners, sync upsell bottom sheets, and promotional marketing cards across file explorer, media player, transfer queue, and account settings in MEGA.
Keep Screen Awake During Transfers & Media - MEGA

Keeps the device screen turned on during active file/folder upload and download transfers, camera auto-uploads, and audio/video playback in MEGA, preventing transfers from stalling when the device enters sleep mode.

Enforces pure pitch-black (#000000) across MEGA's Jetpack Compose theme system (BackgroundColor, ComponentsColor), navigation bar, status bar, and root Activity windows for maximum OLED battery savings.
